headline: An X user trying to copy the success of viral AI influencers found that his own AI characters barely got any views.
score_reason: Lowered from 2: the experiment ran 5 to 8 Oct and is one person's anecdote.
importance_line: It hints that churning out AI influencers does not guarantee an audience, which matters to would-be creators, with the doubt that it is one person's few days of posts.
summary: UNILAD Tech reports that an X user, @notdwd, tried in "Project Jeffy" from 5 October to copy the success of viral AI influencers such as Jean Philanthrope, but the characters Lil Jean and Jeffy drew only a handful of followers and a few hundred views. UNILAD reads this as a sign that the "dead internet theory", the idea that most online activity is bots, is not yet true, though it is a single informal test.
notes: Experiment started 5 Oct 2026 and the latest figures are from 8 Oct 2026.
